title: Beat the Pro Shooting Challenge
description: A challenger must out-shoot a designated 'pro' from a chosen spot before three misses accumulate, a simple and motivating competitive format.

content.objective: Build competitive shooting pressure in a simple, repeatable one-on-one shooting format.
content.setup: A designated 'pro' and a challenger alternate shots from a chosen spot, both shooting after any make.
instructions: The pro shoots first; if they make it, the challenger must match the make or take a loss point.
If the pro misses, the challenger shoots to try to 'take the crown' with a make.
Three total misses for either player ends that player's turn as the pro.
The next challenger in line steps up to face the new pro.
coachingPoints: Stay composed whether shooting to match or shooting to take over.
Use consistent shooting mechanics regardless of the pressure of the format.
Rebound quickly to keep the game moving at a good pace.
commonMistakes: Rushing a shot out of excitement when a chance to 'take the crown' appears.
Getting discouraged after one miss instead of resetting mentally for the next shot.
Losing composure after a bad result instead of resetting for the next one.
content.safety: Keep the shooting area clear of other players' rebounds.
